name: not-found.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  not-found.scss — view-not-found scoped styles: centered 404 layout with
//  the emoji decoration row + message and home link.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../../core/sass/base/placeholders';

.not-found {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;

  // Fixed fullscreen backdrop at 2.5% opacity — a barely-visible wall of
  // repeating text drifting behind the 404 (purely decorative texture).
  &-decoration {
    text-align: left;
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    height: 100vh;
    width: 100vw;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    opacity: 0.025;

    &-marquee {
      font-family: var(--font-primary);
      font-weight: 100;
      will-change: transform;
      width: fit-content;
      white-space: nowrap;

      font-size: to-rem($space-5xl);
      line-height: to-rem($space-5xl);

      @include layout-768() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-4xl);
        line-height: to-rem($space-4xl);
      }

      @include layout-1280() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-5xl);
        line-height: to-rem($space-5xl);
      }

      @include layout-1440() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-6xl);
        line-height: to-rem($space-6xl);
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-7xl);
        line-height: to-rem($space-7xl);
      }

      // 320s cycle ≈ imperceptible drift — slow enough to read as ambience
      // rather than motion (and cheap: transform-only, composited).
      animation: marquee-keyframe 320s linear infinite;
    }
  }

  &-title {
    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    letter-spacing: to-rem($space-md);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);

    @include layout-768() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
      letter-spacing: to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-4xl);
      letter-spacing: to-rem($space-xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-5xl);
      letter-spacing: to-rem($space-2xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);
    }
  }

  // Subtitle rendered by DrawText — sits on its own line
  &-subtitle {
    display: block;
    margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
  }

  &-link {
    @extend %RESETBTN;
    // inlined from .ttl-xs (_fonts.scss not imported here)
    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-size: to-rem(13);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    text-align: center;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
    color: var(--text);
    margin-top: to-rem($space-xl);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
    text-decoration: none;

    // Corner brackets: two L-shaped borders that start as small ticks at the
    // top-left/bottom-right corners, then grow into a near-full frame on
    // hover/focus — a "scope locks onto the link" affordance.
    &::before,
    &::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: to-rem($space-sm);
      height: to-rem($space-sm);
      transition:
        width 0.25s ease,
        height 0.25s ease;
    }
    &::before {
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      border-top: 1px solid currentColor;
      border-left: 1px solid currentColor;
    }
    &::after {
      bottom: 0;
      right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
      border-right: 1px solid currentColor;
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 0.65;
      &::before,
      &::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-2xs)});
      }
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
  }
}

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
